notes.title: Version 0.1.2 Update
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug that may cause Boss Ice dragon stage refresh abnormally.
2. Fixed the bug that may cause the Firefox plot to get stuck.
3. Fixed the material display bug.
4. Fixed the bug about shop selling price.

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed Gamma's image bug when using the katana.
Fixed the bug where Dust would go through the walls.
Fixed gift display problem.
Fixed some wrongly written characters.
Fixed the bug that when talking to multiple NPCs at the same time in the activity room, the text will be covered up.
Optimized the bullets of Heart Cannon.
Adjusted Tome of Summoning.
Adjusted the skill - Fully Stocked.
Adjust the skill - Green Legend.

notes.title: Lunavania Demo Update on October 15
notes.notes:
Fixed the pop-up problem of the demo.
Fixed the vibration of controller that will be caused by the earthquake in the plot .
Fixed the problem that the frame rate in the settings could not be selected with the mouse.
Changed the button for breaking the door in the teaching level.
Changed the default buttons of the controller.
Changed the price of playing mini games in the activity room.
